outcome: maternal complications (anemia, hypertensive disorders, postpartum hemorrhage)
perinatal complications (low birth weight, NICU admission)
cohort: Grand multipara women admitted for labor and delivery at a tertiary care center.
finding: Grand multipara pregnancies are associated with a higher risk of maternal complications like anemia, hypertensive disorders, and postpartum hemorrhage, as well as perinatal complications including low birth weight and NICU admission.
